integrity: The distributional representation follows exactly from the published inverse CDF and the exponential probability transform. Hazard monotonicity is proved by an explicit derivative sign argument for every point of the support. The moment sequence follows from a nonnegative power-series expansion and monotone convergence. The bundled computation is only a finite regression check.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the supremum of running averages of iid mean-one exponential variables.
The hazard classification uses the exact inverse-CDF theorem of Cheliotis and Papadatos as an input.
The moment series is stated only for positive integer orders.
Targeted originality searches may miss an equivalent reliability-theoretic formulation under different terminology.
title: Strict DFR and an exact moment sequence for the maximal exponential running average
